meaning: How the exact 5L Laurent coefficients of this release are written in the constant basis v4 of docs/basis.md. PSLQ forms were found over the 5L campaign period set periods.json (17 monomials of the generators below) and rewritten with identity_map; product masters are Symbolica products of the 1L-4L rows of this repository. Every shipped symbolic row was evaluated numerically and agrees with its numerical row (verified digits per order). Strings using a generator of numerical_identities_of_main are exact only modulo that identity of this repository.

C2.status: definition: C2 = sqrt3 Cl2(pi/3), vakint::cl2 = Cl2(pi/3) (basis v4 #11)

C4.status: definition: C4 = sqrt3 Cl4(pi/3), vakint::cl4 = Cl4(pi/3) (basis v4 #13); used by no form

L3.status: exact modulo main's numerical identity LI3_I_SQRT3_V1 (X3: Im G(0,1,-w;1) -> Im Li3(i/sqrt3), residual 10^-4102.8 at 4100 digits, main docs/basis.md; main labels the Li3(+-i/sqrt3) step COMPUTED, every other HPL/GPL step EXACT): the periods.json relation [2L/P2]_1 = 45/2 + 3/4 pi2 - 6 C2 - 1/6 pi2 pis3 - z3 + 2 C2 ln3 - 3 L3 solved with main's basis-v4 row 2L/P2 eps^1. The resulting relation 270 L3 = sqrt3 (180 Cl2(pi/3) log3 + 432 Im Li3(i/sqrt3) - 32 pi^3 - 9 pi log^2 3) is re-found blind here (rt/tools/l3_lll.py -> rt/out/l3-lll.json: own integral LLL, 12-element superset with 7 decoys, every value by mpmath, same relation at 120 / 200 / 300 digits, decoys 0, E = 287.3 at 300 d; independent of the reviewer's mpmath PSLQ run, which found it too)

PR11dep0.status: main's numerical identity: basis-v4 row 4L/P17 eps^0 = closed formula of PR11d[0] (main docs/basis.md: COMPUTED+VALIDATED closure, 544 digits vs the 20000-digit value); not re-found blind here, verified here against the 20006-digit v0.1.2 payload to the working precision; S*: contains D=2 periods (520 d) and K5 moments (20000 d)

SUN2.status: definition: SUN2 = [2L/P2]_2 (periods.json), main's exact basis-v4 row 2L/P2 eps^2

numerical_identities_of_main.LI3_I_SQRT3_V1/X3: Im G(0,1,-w;1) -> Im Li3(i/sqrt3) = vakint::PolylogImag(3,3^(1/2)*i/3); residual 10^-4102.8 at 4100 digits (main: COMPUTED)
numerical_identities_of_main.X4: Im G(0,1,1,-w;1) -> Im Li4(i/sqrt3) = vakint::PolylogImag(4,3^(1/2)*i/3); residual 10^-4100.4 at 4100 digits (main: COMPUTED)
numerical_identities_of_main.PR11d[0] closure: closed formula of PR11d[0] = 4L/P17 eps^0 (D2 jets, K5 moments, classical): COMPUTED+VALIDATED, 544 digits vs 20000
numerical_identities_of_main.R1: 48-term relation among D=2 jets (PR11dD2Eps2 expressed), 547 digits; enters only through main rows containing PR11dD2Eps2 terms

l3_blind_refinding.method: integral LLL (own implementation) on a 12-element superset (5 target monomials + 7 decoys), every value by mpmath

evaluation_only_values.what: decimals used only to evaluate strings containing D5bar1/2, D6bar1/2, T111bar4 and GPLs #18-#20 (vakint evaluates them itself): solved from the 1L-4L rows of this repository and their numerical payloads; every other row reproduced

symp_v4_forms.meaning: Orders identified by PSLQ directly over basis-v4 elements (no periods.json translation; string in Symbolica normal form): exact only modulo the listed numerical identities of this repository and, for S*, the listed 4L constants.
